# Foreign/AUR packages — NOT installed by install.sh (pure official Arch
# repositories setup). Install these manually after a fresh setup to match a
# fully-configured machine:
#
#   sudo pacman -S --needed yay && yay -S yay-bin cloudflare-warp-bin cliamp-bin
#
# yay-bin              AUR helper used by optional scripts/tooling
# cloudflare-warp-bin  Cloudflare WARP VPN (personal use)
# cliamp-bin           Terminal music player (config via config/cliamp/, folder
#                      playlists auto-generated from ~/Music by install.sh)
